purpose: Fan-game library care pixels, generated by the same rules used in-game

floor_grime.columns: severity 1..3; growing visible coverage, dark grime, footprints and crumpled paper
floor_grime.mask: Authored floor and furniture silhouettes; characters render above grime
floor_grime.click: Visible nontransparent stain pixels, including the outer edge

clutter: Stepped leaning book stacks count actual returned books; used tables show tipped cups, spills and loose pages; cleared by existing filing and tidying actions

fallen_books.rows: closed / open with central fold and writing
fallen_books.stages: none at level 1; one book at level 2; up to two books at level 3 where space permits
fallen_books.placement: Only complete books that fit the visible floor, never clipped by furniture
fallen_books.cleanup: Gather books before mopping in the existing three-second area action; no extra inventory or chore

ete_body: Existing whole-body cheer gesture atlas, new timing and a rigid one-pixel foot tap; no modified facial geometry or new official character trait
cleaning: Three-second authored tool motion, no economy reward
